German: welcher / welche / welches / welchem / welchen (which) – changeable (der-word, declines by gender/case)
Welcher Mann? Welche Frau? Welches Kind? Welchem Freund? Welchen Hund?
English: (Which man? Which woman? Which child? Which friend? Which dog?)
(to whom – dative) – changeable form of wer
(To whom are you giving the book?)
